Snap “Saturday”: Independence Day 2025

By Spider-Vice / 6th July 2025
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:04
Instaread

Welcome to Snap Saturday, GTANet’s ode to the virtual photography community who continue to capture some amazingly creative shots across GTA and Red Dead.

The 4th of July has come and gone, but this doesn’t mean that anyone stops celebrating that easily! In Los Santos, Independence Day is taken like a serious life-or-death matter, and the record amounts of Patriot Beer drank on that week will be enough to keep every river flowing in a drought… just not with water.

Special liveries, fireworks for everyone, special clothing that folks have gotten out of their wardrobes, the meanest of American muscle cars, and much more, are the highlights for yet another Independence Day in Los Santos. Celebrated for 11 years now, there’s no shortage of America-themed things to do, and this week, we’re seeing it all from your lenses.

Enjoy! RAHHHh! 🦅🇺🇸

Post your photos on GTAForums or use the #GTAOnline / #RedDeadOnline / #RedDeadRedemption2 / #RedDeadRedemption hashtags on (X)itter or Bluesky (check us out!) and you might see your efforts highlighted in future GTANet Snap Saturdays!
